RL2 anchors both ends to the snapshot fact global.routeOptimization.completedAt. due2 has no fact-anchored window: a relative dprod:deadline is activation + duration, and activation is the instant the instance was first owed, supplied by the shell. RL2's end is exclusive and dprod:deadline inclusive, a one-instant difference accepted. RL2 leaves the snapshot time unstated and names Fulfilled, Active, or Violated by time and evidence; scenarios 1, 3, and 4 cover the three. Scenarios 2–4 are added.
